# Button

Buttons in four variants (primary, secondary, ghost, danger) plus a rest variant for break screens, in three sizes, with loading and disabled states.

`CLR.Button` · Controls

## Use

```jsx
<CLR.Button>…</CLR.Button>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="CLR.Button">…</x-import>
```

## Props (ButtonProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `ReactNode` |  |
| `variant` | `'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'ghost' \| 'danger' \| 'rest'` |  |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | sm 36px (44px hit area), md 44px, lg 52px. Default md. |
| `icon` | `ComponentType<LucideProps>` |  |
| `iconRight` | `ComponentType<LucideProps>` |  |
| `iconOnly` | `boolean` | Square, label goes to aria-label. |
| `block` | `boolean` | Full width. |
| `loading` | `boolean` |  |
| `loadingLabel` | `string` | Replaces the label while loading, e.g. "Signing in…". |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |
| `pressed` | `boolean` | For toggling buttons such as Do Not Disturb. |
| `type` | `'button' \| 'submit'` |  |
| `onClick` | `() => void` |  |
